activity.notes: The Dutch West India Company appointed Peter Stuyvesant to lead New Netherland in 1647. He remained Director-General until the English seizure and surrender of New Netherland in 1664. ATLAS uses year granularity because contemporary Dutch/English calendar conventions produce variant exact-day renderings in modern sources.

sources.title: The Rise and Fall of New Netherland — U.S. National Park Service
sources.citation_text: The National Park Service records Peter Stuyvesant as Director-General of New Netherland from 1647 to 1664.
